dict.string: AirLink uses your location permission only to read the name of the Wi-Fi network you are connected to. macOS restricts Wi-Fi network names unless an app has Location access. Your location is never recorded or sent anywhere.
AirLink uses your location permission only to read the name of the Wi-Fi network you are connected to. Your location is never recorded or sent anywhere.
AirLink connects to your campus network's local captive portal so you can sign in and verify your internet connection.
